description: This header file defines prototypes for time conversion functions related to time zone offsets, local-to-UTC and UTC-to-local conversions, and splitting block days. It appears to be part of a larger software project involving time handling and data modeling.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Returns the current timezone offset as a time_t value.

methods.name: ConvLocalToUTC
methods.description: Converts local time string to UTC time string.

methods.name: ConvUTCToLocal
methods.description: Converts UTC time string to local time string.

methods.name: split_BlockDays
methods.description: Splits given start and end block days into arrays or strings.
